column6: SPR-252 Invite by email: upload a contact list
column7:
*Story:* Excel/CSV import with de-duplication (FR-27.13, FR-27.17).

h3. Acceptance criteria
* Given an Excel file with Full Name, Email ID and Mobile Number columns (50 rows, 3 repeated), when I upload it on the Invite by email tab, then I see "47 added · 3 repeated in the file", the rows appear as Not sent yet and the counters update
* Given the same file, when I upload it again, then the summary says 0 added and nothing is duplicated
* Given a CSV without a header row and a row with only a mobile number, when I upload it, then emails and mobiles are still recognised; the mobile-only row shows "Mobile only" and is counted under Mobile only
* Given a file whose rows have no email or mobile, when I upload it, then the summary says how many rows had no usable email or mobile and nothing is added
* Given a list with people on it, when I search, filter by status, export CSV, remove one row and Clear list, then each works and the counters follow

h3. Details
* Priority: P1   * Effort: 3 pts   * Suggested sprint: S2
* Depends on: SPR-244
* Epic: E08 Events — Administration
* Reference: SPR-TechForge-SRS-BRS-v2.1 (module in the epic)

column6: SPR-253 Invite by email: edit, preview and test the invitation
column7:
*Story:* Per-event wording with placeholders and a live preview (FR-27.14, FR-27.15).

h3. Acceptance criteria
* Given the default wording, when I open the tab, then the preview shows banner, headline, message, facts box (when, where, speaker, free), the learning points, an orange button, closing line and an opt-out line
* Given I change the subject and message using {{first_name}} and **bold**, when I look at the preview, then the placeholders are replaced with the first person's details and the bold text is bold
* Given edited wording, when I click Save wording and reload the page, then the wording persists; Reset to default restores the built-in text
* Given my address in "Send a test to yourself", when I click Send test, then I receive the email with a [TEST] subject within a couple of minutes and every link opens the event page with ?ref=email
* Given the live site's event link pasted in "Registration link to use" (on QA), when I look at the preview and send a test, then the button and links use the live link with ?ref=email; a plain "sprtechforge.com" shows a red hint and is ignored

h3. Details
* Priority: P1   * Effort: 3 pts   * Suggested sprint: S2
* Depends on: SPR-252
* Epic: E08 Events — Administration
* Reference: SPR-TechForge-SRS-BRS-v2.1 (module in the epic)

column6: SPR-254 Invite by email: send to the list and track registrations
column7:
*Story:* Outbox send with resumable statuses and attribution (FR-27.16, FR-27.17).

h3. Acceptance criteria
* Given 5 people Not sent yet and 1 Mobile only, when I click Send invitation, then the button says 5 people, a confirmation appears, progress reaches 5/5 and the five rows become Invited with a time
* Given one invited person registers through the emailed button, when I open the Overview tab, then Registrations by source shows email = 1 and that person's row shows Registered ✓
* Given a send in progress, when I click Stop, then the remaining rows stay Not sent yet and the button offers them again
* Given a row marked Failed, when I tick Include failed and send, then it is retried; with "Also resend" ticked, Invited rows are included and show ×2 afterwards
* Given a draft (unpublished) event, when I try to send, then I am told to publish first and nothing is sent

h3. Details
* Priority: P0   * Effort: 3 pts   * Suggested sprint: S2
* Depends on: SPR-253,SPR-282
* Epic: E08 Events — Administration
* Reference: SPR-TechForge-SRS-BRS-v2.1 (module in the epic)

*Story:* Follow-up email with Yes/No buttons, public survey page with two branches, Feedback tab (FR-27.18–20, FR-28.17, BR-27.4).

h3. Acceptance criteria
* Given a completed event and a list of registrants uploaded on the Invite tab, when I switch "What to send" to Follow-up survey, set the Next session label and send a test to myself, then the mail asks "Did you join the live session?" with a Yes and a No button; each opens the survey page with that answer and my email pre-filled; the next session text appears in the mail
* Given the survey page opened from the No button, when I pick "link did not work on my phone", next session Yes, recording Yes, course Maybe, mode Online, time Evening and submit, then a thank-you card confirms the next session details and the recording; the Feedback tab shows my row once with the reason, and the "Why people did not join" bar updates
* Given the same email opens the page again and answers Yes with 4 stars, when I submit, then the earlier row is updated, not duplicated; Avg rating and Joined counters update
* Given the page with no answer chosen or an invalid email, when I try to submit, then I am blocked with a clear message and nothing is saved
* Given answers on the Feedback tab, when I filter Interested in course, click Copy emails, and Export CSV, then the filter keeps only yes/maybe rows, the clipboard holds their emails, and the CSV contains reason, next session, course interest and comments

* Priority: P1   * Effort: 3 pts   * Suggested sprint: S2
